WhiteDNS shared scanner Android source snapshot

Source: https://github.com/TaJirax/whitedns-scanner
The engine/ and mobile/ packages and their embedded ASN CSV files are copied
without changes from the local working tree recorded in SCANNER_SOURCE.json.
The source repository does not contain a standalone license declaration; no
additional license grant is asserted by this vendor snapshot.

The embedded filtered_ipv4.csv / filtered_ipv6.csv tables are retained byte for
byte. The upstream engine/asn.go attributes their source to cleanip-finder.
The Go golang.org/x package licenses used by the scanner/mobile build are
retained alongside this notice. Dependency versions remain in go.mod/go.sum.
